project: ChefZC personal homepage / Atlas 0.3 exhibition, Now milestone and field notes
brief: Bring the personal-site Atlas presentation into the application's Renaissance observatory and painted cosmos, while keeping the site's collection, timeline and journal structures usable.
constraints: Keep the existing Now timeline and the order of other projects and posts.
Use Atlas 0.3 artwork and verified knowledge counts; do not present decorative constellation coordinates as real graph data.
Maintain Chinese and English versions, keyboard paths, responsive layout and reduced-motion behavior.
assumptions: The requested Now and Post redesign applies to the current Atlas entry and its article; earlier entries retain their project-specific art direction.
The three observatory plates are editorial views that link into the working Atlas application.

decisions.choice: A full-width painted overture, manuscript prologue, numerical ledger, three switchable celestial plates and closing invitation.
decisions.reason: The Atlas entry should feel like a complete exhibition while retaining direct routes into the application, source and field notes.

decisions.choice: Keep the site's timeline and journal frames; place an Atlas micro observatory in the Now art window and a matching editorial plate in the latest post and reader.
decisions.reason: Preserves the reading chronology and each older project's own identity.

decisions.choice: Canvas starlight, slow SVG instruments, staged scroll reveals, an interactive light and view changes with an explicit pause control.
decisions.reason: Give the observatory a sense of time and discovery without delaying access to content.

direction.name: The illuminated observatory
visible_rules: Renaissance architectural frescoes act as monumental openings and close views.
Lapis blue space and thin brass instruments carry the active exploration areas.
Warm vellum sheets and classical lettering hold reading, facts and calls to action.
direction.signature: A painted cosmos unfolds into a working folio of three celestial plates.
avoid: Generic card grids inside the Atlas exhibit
Continuous motion without a pause path

layout.structure: Gallery collection > Atlas overture > prologue > 3-plus-1 fact ledger > 3-plate observatory > epilogue; existing Now timeline and Posts order stay intact.
layout.mobile_order: The observatory rail precedes the active plate in DOM and visual order.

motion.implementation: 72 deterministic canvas stars (44 on narrow stages), DPR capped at 1.5; slow 85-100 second SVG rotation; pause offscreen and when document is hidden.
GSAP ScrollTrigger reveals overture, headings and facts; short figure crop scrubs with reading.
Plate controls update aria-pressed and live content; pointer light follows only while motion is enabled.
Global motion switch and prefers-reduced-motion turn off continuous movement and staged transforms; content remains visible.

environment.delivery: Static dist with Vercel project chefzc-homepage

limitations: The plate illustrations are editorial; the actual node positions and tools are in /atlas/.
Hardware frame-time and 200% browser zoom were not measured in this pass.
